_about: Alfred North Whitehead (1861-1947), from Project Gutenberg: The Organisation of Thought (Williams and Norgate, 1917), The Concept of Nature (Tarner Lectures, 1920), Science and the Modern World (Macmillan, 1925) and Symbolism, its Meaning and Effect (Macmillan, 1927). Added in round az: Process and Reality, an essay in cosmology, Gifford Lectures 1927-28 (New York: Macmillan, published October 1929; raw IA OCR, clean 0.90). Added in round az: Religion in the Making, Lowell Lectures 1926 (New York: Macmillan, 1926; raw IA OCR, clean 0.92). Added in round az: An Enquiry concerning the Principles of Natural Knowledge (Cambridge: University Press, 1919; raw IA OCR, clean 0.89). Added in round az: The Principle of Relativity, with applications to physical science (Cambridge: University Press, 1922; raw IA OCR, clean 0.85). All published before 1931, so US public domain. Held: An Introduction to Mathematics (Home University Library; no year printed in any of three IA scans) and Principia Mathematica with Russell (IA OCR of the symbolism cleans to 0.45). No uids minted.
